 toks=re.findall(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|[{}=\[\],]|[^\s{}=\[\],]+',s)
 pos=0
 def val():
  nonlocal pos
  if pos>=len(toks): return None
  t=toks[pos]
  if t=='[':
   pos+=1; a=[]

 def obj():
